mentions.name: StressingLLMs
mentions.description: This project explores reverse engineering using LLMs together with Ghidra, with a particular focus on how code complexity affects the LLM-assisted analysis process. Results of experiments run with opencode are published as a write-up on GitHub Pages.
mentions.problem: Understanding how complexity affects the reverse engineering process when using LLMs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been exploring reverse engineering using LLMs and Ghidra. A particular interest is in trying to understand how complexity can affect the process. I’m still learning but it’s been a fun way to explore LLMs. Here are my results using opencode  https://alexander-hanel.github.io/StressingLLMs/opencode.html
mentions.author: __alexander
